verdict.rationale: Kimi's API platform is /v1 path-versioned, has a date-versioned Admin API spec, and publishes a dated model deprecation table with migration guidance. Evidence also notes there is no standalone deprecation-policy document and no API changelog, so the 'documented deprecation policy' part rests only on per-model deprecation notices. The API is also a separate Open Platform product from the assistant app. Missing for 10: a formal published deprecation policy (notice periods, guarantees), an API changelog, and independent corroboration of the versioning and deprecation practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: The API is /v1 path-versioned (OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible bases) and the platform publishes a dated model deprecation table with migration guidance covering API model IDs
